jobs.occupation: (Senior) Product Creation Learning Partner – Maternity Cover (Minimum 12 Months)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building change management and learning capabilities and fostering a learning culture at scale? Do you thrive when working with tools and processes, and are you naturally curious about finding new ways to use them? If so, you could be our Senior Product Creation Learning Partner during a maternity cover of at least 12 months.

At 3Shape, Product Creation is our term for R&D. It represents the organization responsible for developing and improving our products across hardware, software, engineering, and related product-development disciplines.

We are looking for an experienced learning partner to join us on a fixed-term maternity cover. In this role, you will build and embed a scalable capability framework that ensures Product Creation teams are equipped to work effectively across processes, tools, and ways of working.

During the maternity-cover period, you will use your stakeholder-engagement skills and your ability to align and influence across organizational levels and functions. You will combine these strengths with solid experience in building and maintaining training frameworks and structures that fit the organization’s needs.

You will be part of the Product Creation Excellence (PCE) team, which consists of around 10 people, all based in Denmark. Together, we enable Product Creation and adjacent functions across processes, training, tools, strategy, and transformation.

Core Responsibilities

Training framework & architecture

• Define the learning and capability framework and structures that support tool and process adoption, ways of working, and competence building: Standardize how training is designed, deployed, and maintained (including anchoring structures, super-user and ambassador methodologies, communities of practice, learning journeys, etc.).

• Continuously improve and expand the learning and capability framework and plan for Product Creation in collaboration with the Product Creation team.

• Develop and anchor training: Enable and support the organization to own and deliver training locally where appropriate, while ensuring central support and training structures are available where needed.

Capability mapping and training roll-out

• Continuously map and prioritize training needs with stakeholders based on business needs, maturity across technical functions, necessity, and criticality.

• Define and drive rollout plans in collaboration with functional owners and/or the PCE team.

• Establish regular cadences for training areas and structures, ensuring an appropriate frequency of training events, reviews of training materials, trainer setup and coaching, and cycles for communities of practice and other learning environments.

Integration with business & transformation

• Ensure alignment with transformation initiatives and operating model changes.

• Support change management and the adoption of new practices.

Capability tracking & improvement

• Define and follow up on KPIs for capability building (e.g., adoption, proficiency, and coverage).

• Drive feedback loops and the continuous improvement of the training setup.

• Maintain an overview of capability gaps and critical skill needs.

This role may involve some travel.

Ideal profile:

For this role, we believe a good fit is someone who can bring:

• Experience in building learning frameworks in complex medical regulated R&D or technology organizations (including experience with different training and learning models, e.g., train-the-trainer, communities of practice, coaching, and online training).

• A collaborative, team-oriented mindset. We depend on strong teamwork within the PCE team and across other teams and functions, so it is essential that you thrive when working with others to solve challenges and realize opportunities.

• An understanding of and/or interest in how different profiles learn, with the ability to balance technical tool training with soft skills such as leadership.

• Experience with change management and the large-scale rollout and/or adoption of new processes, preferably in a large R&D or other technical environment.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build bridges between technical and non-technical functions.

• The ability to drive adoption without formal authority.

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

At 3Shape, you will join an international R&D environment in central Copenhagen, working closely with advanced hardware, software, and engineering teams that develop products to improve dental care globally. You will have the opportunity to shape learning and capability-building practices and see your work make a direct difference for colleagues.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international place to work. But most of all, we are a diverse group of over 50 different nationalities who all contribute to a thriving company culture. We partake in social clubs, monthly social activities, and various in-team activities as well. If that’s not enough, then add on:

• Central Copenhagen location.

• A globally recognized technology company.

• An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• Breakfast every day and a delicious, healthy lunch prepared by our private chefs.

• A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Join us for a maternity cover of at least 12 months and be part of a team improving treatment and care in a meaningful industry. We encourage all qualified professionals who are passionate about building strong learning capabilities in a complex product-development environment to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis; however, we plan to conduct interviews in October and November.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

jobs.occupation: Client Manager
jobs.description:
**Client Management

**As part of the production of our digital marketing products, we are looking for a Client Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you support our clients throughout their website journey, from the first conversation to publication, and help them get the most out of their new digital presence quickly and smoothly.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• You will contact our Dutch- and English-speaking customers across the world (no sales) via welcome calls for our website and digital marketing products.

• You will discuss the clients' requirements for their website, consult on structure, and ensure all expectations are clearly defined, keeping the bigger picture of their business goals in mind.

• After the website has been created by our web designers, you will coordinate final revision requests and ensure successful publication.

• You will handle domain and email account transfers on behalf of clients.

• You increasingly work alongside AI-supported tools that simplify parts of the process, giving you more time to focus on the client rather than paperwork.

• With your positive, consultative and service-oriented approach, you contribute daily to delivering an outstanding client experience.

**Your profile

**

• You have professional experience in client service and enjoy daily client interaction.

• Your affinity for digital products and processes allows you to quickly familiarise yourself with new systems, including AI-supported tools and workflows.

• You have a basic understanding of website structure and design principles, and you can explain steps and results to clients in an understandable way.

• Experience with CRM systems is a plus.

• You have excellent written and spoken Dutch and English language skills.

**Why this role is different

**You are not just processing requests. You guide clients through one of the most visible moments in their business, the launch of their new website, and you see the direct result of your work go live. You work closely with an international team, and increasingly alongside AI supported tools that take over routine steps in the process. That gives you more room to focus on what actually matters, the client in front of you.

**About Us

**group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.

When you join group.one, you become a part of a global network that values collaboration, growth, and excellence. Join us in creating online success stories!

**We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

****We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here - what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

****We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

**Welcome to one.com, where innovation meets passion. We are a leading web hosting and domain registration company dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses online. Since 2002, we have been committed to delivering reliable, user-friendly, and affordable web services. Our mission is to make it easy for anyone to build and maintain an online presence, and we believe in integrity, innovation, and putting our customers first.

jobs.occupation: Manager, Global Operations Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
_Do you want to shape how Pandora leverages data, analytics, and AI to drive operational excellence globally? Are you passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights, building high-performing teams, and enabling better decision-making at scale? Then you could be the Manager, Global Operations Analytics & Insights we're looking for!

_As Manager, Global Operations Analytics & Insights, you will lead Pandora's Global Omni Operations analytics agenda, ensuring trusted data, meaningful insights, and consistent performance measurement across regions, channels, and functions. You will act as the business owner of Operations data and analytics, driving the strategy, governance, and capabilities required to support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Working closely with stakeholders across Global Omni Operations, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology, Finance, and other business functions, you will ensure that analytics, data, and AI-enabled investments are aligned with business priorities and deliver measurable value. You will partner closely with Data & Analytics to co-own the analytics roadmap, balancing business priorities with technical foundations, platform capabilities, and long-term scalability. You will also drive adoption of increasingly data-driven ways of working and help Operations leaders translate insights into decisions and action. Success in this role is measured not only by delivering analytics capabilities, but by ensuring they are adopted and create tangible business impact across Global Omni Operations.

Leading a team, you will play a critical role in strengthening operational visibility, performance measurement, and decision-making capabilities while enabling Pandora to scale and optimize its global operations.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own the Global Omni Operations analytics and data strategy, roadmap and priorities in close partnership with Data & Analytics

• Act as the business owner for Operations data, KPI frameworks and performance measurement standards

• Own and govern the Omni Operations analytics demand funnel, including intake, prioritization and roadmap management and value realization tracking

• Drive adoption of analytics solutions and insights, ensuring they are translated into business decisions and measurable operational value

• Ensure trusted, consistent and scalable Omni Operations data, reporting and analytics capabilities that enable business decision-making and operational improvements

• Drive alignment and adoption across Omni Operations functions, regions and stakeholders on performance measuremen, analytics priorities and data-driven ways of working

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for advanced analytics and AI-enabled decision making

• Build strong partners with Operations, D&A and D&T teams

• Lead and develop the Operations Analytics and Insights team

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring experience within analytics, performance management, operational excellence, or business intelligence, combined with a strong ability to translate business challenges into scalable data and insight solutions.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Experience leading analytics, performance management or operational excellence activities

• Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business performance measurement and data-driven decision-making

• Experience working across multiple operational functions in a global environment

• Experience influencing stakeholders and driving alignment across functions

• Understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities

**We Hope To See

**

• You have a strategic and analytical mindset

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills

• You are an effective communicator and decision-maker

• Collaborative and approachable leader with a continuous improvement mindset

• Curious, proactive and results-oriented

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global Operations Excellence organization, where you will be responsible for leading the Analytics & Insights agenda across our Global Omni Operations network. Working closely with stakeholders across Operations, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology, Finance, and regional teams, you will help shape the future of operational performance measurement, analytics capabilities, and AI-enabled decision-making.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence strategic priorities, build analytics capabilities at scale, and create tangible business impact across Pandora's global operations network.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4B

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. The result is a professional and dynamic space that delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through thousands of points of sale worldwide. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs approximately 39,000 people globally and is committed to sustainability, innovation, and creating meaningful experiences for customers around the world.

Engineering a Greener and Safer World

This results in a product portfolio recognised for long service life, exceptional durability and proven sustainability.

jobs.occupation: SPAR NORD ARENA SØGER BY BANEFORVALTER
jobs.description:
Spar Nord Arena - Aalborg Væddeløbsbane SØGER NY BANEFORVALTER

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. Vi afvikler både trav- og galopløb på vores 18 ha. store område, og som baneforvalter får du ansvaret for at både vores baner og vores område spiller til såvel løb som træning. Stillingen er fuld tid, og vores nye baneforvalter skal i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og tre kollegaer der hjælper med at passe bane og område, sikre at vi opretholder et højt niveau på vores sportslige faciliteter og omgivelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

·At foretage reparationer / vedligehold på maskiner og bygninger.

·At passe vores grønne område.

·Øvrigt forefaldende arbejde.

Din profil: Vi lægger vægt på at du har erfaring med traktorer, redskaber og maskiner i almindelighed. Du må gerne have hænderne skruet rigtigt på, så du uden problemer kan udføre løbende reparationer.

Indgangsvinklen til jobbet kan f.eks. være maskinfører, landmand, greenkeeper, vicevært, banemand eller aktiv udøver.

Da vores løb afvikles når andre har fri (aften og/eller weekend), er det et krav, at du kan arbejde på disse dage.

Vi tilbyder: Et godt og stabilt job med frihed under ansvar. En løn som matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette. Da vi afholder samtaler løbende, opfordrer vi dig til at søge stillingen hellere i dag end i morgen.

For yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kontakt banechef Lars Hellerup.

jobs.description:

• 2 years of experience in program or project management.

• Experience with facilities real estate management.

• Ability to communicate in Danish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in vendor relationships and agreement management.

• Experience in providing support for budgeting, forecasting, and purchase orders.

• Experience in SAP or equivalent.

• Experience with local authority, tax and administration.

About The Job

As a Data Center Site Business Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the service agreements of data center related systems. You will lead cost control, contractor management, and procurement projects, collaborating with other stakeholders (e.g., Environment, Health, and Safety department). You will actively support local data center technicians by ensuring they are sufficiently informed regarding relevant processes. You will serve as a local escalation point for finance related matters. You will support the site management and other Business Operations Program Managers in the global team in maintaining key metrics, providing data, and conducting analyses to facilitate informed decision-making.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.640000 - kr.655000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you want to work at the intersection of technology, customers and product management, helping ensure that sensing products remain competitive, commercially attractive and easy to sell throughout their lifecycle?

Danfoss Sensing Solutions, part of Danfoss Climate Solutions, is looking for a Product Specialist to join our Application & Product Support organization. In this role, you will combine technical product knowledge with operational product management, supporting the day-to-day management of our sensor portfolio and ensuring that product data, documentation, pricing and commercial information are accurate and available to the organization.

You will work closely with Product Management, Sales, Engineering and Supply Chain. You will help turn decisions into practical implementation, coordinate activities across functions, and ensure that released products are properly maintained throughout their lifecycle.

The role offers an opportunity to build a broad understanding of sensing technologies, applications and commercial product management in an international organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Support Product Management in the day-to-day coordination of the sensor portfolio, helping maintain released products throughout their lifecycle and coordinating practical activities related to product introductions, product changes, phase-outs and other portfolio updates

• Maintain product master data, technical documentation, sales literature and pricing information, ensuring accuracy, consistency and availability across the organization

• Coordinate evaluations of new product variants and customer requests, driving implementation across Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain

• Act as a trusted product and application expert for internal stakeholders, supporting technical evaluations, product selection, customer interactions and training activities

• Drive coordination and continuous improvement activities that strengthen collaboration, simplify processes and improve product information quality across the organization

**What We're Looking For

**You are structured, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of operational tasks. You enjoy working with both technical and commercial topics and understand the importance of accuracy, timely follow-up and clear communication.

**In Addition, We Expect That

**

• You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Engineering or a related technical or commercial field and have experience from product support, product management, engineering, sales support or a similar role within a technical organization

• A genuine interest in sensing technologies and their applications is a strong plus. Experience with pressure, temperature or other sensing technologies is advantageous

• You understand, or are motivated to learn, the commercial and operational aspects of managing technical products throughout their lifecycle

• You are comfortable working with product data, technical documentation, pricing information and structured processes, bringing strong analytical and organizational skills.

• You have proven ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and functions, ensuring timely implementation and follow-through

• You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who builds strong relationships and understands that success comes from enabling teams across Danfoss to deliver results together. You are fluent in English, both spoken and written

Experience with product information management, ERP systems, master data, lifecycle management or technical documentation would be an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join an experienced and collaborative organization where technical knowledge, product understanding and customer needs come together. You will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of sensing technologies while gaining practical experience with operational product management and global product lifecycle processes.

We promote development from within and support learning through collaboration, mentoring, training and access to global opportunities.

You will have flexibility, autonomy and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We strive to create an inclusive working environment where people of different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and valued.

Benefits may include annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance and other locally applicable benefits.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the position, please contact, Director, Application & Product Support Christian Dall Larsen, +45 2966 7369

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Automation Specialist | Maternity Cover
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**At Boozt, we are rethinking how we connect with our customers through data, personalisation, automation and AI. As our CRM setup continues to evolve, we are looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who wants to help shape the next chapter.

This is an opportunity to take an active role in developing how we work with marketing automation at Boozt. You will join a team with ambitions to make our communication smarter, more relevant and more data-driven, with room to challenge existing approaches and explore how new technology can improve the way we work.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise with curiosity and a drive to make things better, this is your chance to make a real impact on how we do CRM at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of our CRM team, working hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud to build and manage automated communications across email, app push and SMS. You will work closely with customer data to set up segmentation and personalisation, design targeted communications and continuously improve how we reach our customers.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Build and manage automated communications and recurring campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).

• 
Set up audience segmentation and personalisation using customer data, including SQL and AMPscript where relevant.

• 
Design and build personalised communications across email, app push and SMS.

• 
Analyse campaign performance, run A/B tests and use insights to improve results.

• 
Work closely with the CRM and market teams to ensure relevant communication across markets.

• 
Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we build, personalise and optimise customer communications.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You have hands-on experience with marketing automation and enjoy combining technical execution with analytical thinking and a curiosity for what is possible. You take ownership of your work, look for ways to improve and are comfortable exploring new approaches.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
Around 3 years of experience with marketing automation, preferably within CRM.

• 
Experience with a platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe, Agillic, Voyado, Bloomreach or Klaviyo.

• 
A solid understanding of segmentation, personalisation, automated journeys and campaign testing.

• 
Experience working with campaign KPIs and using data to improve performance.

• 
An interest in AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and how they can support your daily work.

• 
Strong written communication skills and fluency in English.

Experience with SQL and AMPscript, as well as working across multiple markets, is a plus.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will join a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you have the freedom and responsibility to make a real impact. As part of our CRM team, you will work at the intersection of customer experience, data, technology and commercial growth. This approximately 14-month maternity cover is an opportunity to take ownership, explore new ideas and help shape the customer experience for millions of customers while developing your skills in e-commerce CRM.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant (ERP Property Management Or Real Estate)
jobs.description:
About us.

At YAVICA, people are at the heart of everything we do. Founded in 2017 by a group of industry experts and tech enthusiasts, we have grown into a diverse and talented team from across the globe.

Spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, we combine our unique perspectives and skills with a shared mission: to provide the best end-to-end business solution for real estate visionaries. Our solutions are embedded in Microsoft Dynamics 365, leveraging its power to deliver innovative, scalable, and efficient tools for the real estate industry.

What makes YAVICA different? It’s our people. Here, every voice matters, and we support each other in achieving great things. We’re passionate about the real estate industry and the technology that fuels it, and we’re excited about the future as we continue to grow together.

About the role:

We are seeking a motivated and experienced Senior Functional Consultant with a strong knowledge in the real estate and property industry and proven expertise in ERP.

As part of our Client Services team, you will collaborate with an international network of colleagues and clients. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor, helping clients optimise their business processes, maximise the value of their YAVICA products with Dynamics 365 Finance, and achieve measurable results.

You will support clients within Europe to transform their business by implementing FlexProperty, YAVICA’s real estate solution built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, while fostering long-term partnerships built on trust and value creation.

What you will be responsible for:

• Work closely with customers, developers and other consultants to deliver high-quality solutions.

• Lead customer workshops and translate real-estate business requirements into practical configured standard solutions.

• Configure YAVICA FlexProperty and advise customers on how to get the most from standard functionality.

• Perform FIT/GAP analysis and help design solutions where additional functionality, integrations or customisations are required.

• Support customers throughout implementation, including testing, data migration, training, and go-live.

• Take ownership of your work, ensuring agreed deliverables are completed on time and in line with our project methodology.

You might be a great fit if you have:

• Strong experience with enterprise property management or real estate ERP solutions, covering areas such as lease administration, service charge reconciliation, indexation and lease accounting.

• Proven consulting experience implementing ERP or property management solutions.

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise and challenge customers when needed.

• A structured and hands-on approach, with the ability to take ownership of your deliverables and work independently within a project team.

What we offer:

At YAVICA, we care deeply about creating an environment where people thrive, both personally and professionally. Here’s what you can look forward to as part of our team:

• 
Work-life harmony: We offer flexibility to help you balance your work and personal life in a way that works best for you.

• 
Flexible hybrid working: Whether you’re collaborating in the office or focusing from home, our hybrid work model empowers you to do your best work, wherever you are.

• 
Collaborative culture: No micromanagement here. We trust our team members and value everyone’s input. Your ideas and contributions matter.

• 
Growth opportunities: We’re invested in your development. Enjoy opportunities for training, skill-building, and career progression as YAVICA continues to grow.

At YAVICA, we celebrate individuality and diversity, committed to fostering a workplace where everyone is valued, regardless of background, identity, or ability. Join us in creating something extraordinary together.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Project Manager to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

As Project Manager in NPI you will work closely together with optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers on maturing design and developing assembly and test processes. When the project has proven the product can be manufactured with satisfactory yield, it will be transferred to Operations, freeing up space and resources for the new next project.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead maturation and transfer projects of laser products.

• Be responsible for planning resource alignment, risk and change management, project reporting, and follow-up the gate process to ensure projects are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.

**What You Bring

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering.

**Essential

**

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects, ideally related to product development, product maturation, or technology transfer.

• Ability to effectively lead technical specialists and facilitate project meetings, design reviews, and key decision-making processes.

• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.

• Communicate fluently in English and thrive in cross-functional, international teams.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus programme.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

_Benefits are subject to eligibility and the relevant plan or policy terms.

_**Practical Information

**

• Working arrangement: On site

• Working language: English

• Employment: Full time

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.occupation: Nordic Quality Manager
jobs.employer_name: Konica Minolta Business Solutions Denmark a/s
jobs.description:
At Konica Minolta, we believe great workplaces are built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a Nordic Quality Manager who is passionate about creating structure, driving positive change, and helping our Nordic organization operate at high standards of quality, sustainability, and information security.

This is not just a compliance role. It is an opportunity to influence how we work, support leaders and teams across the Nordics, and make a real impact on our customers, employees, and business.

What you'll be doing

As one of our Nordic Quality Managers, you will help to improve our Integrated Management System (IMS), covering Quality, Environment, and Information Security. You will work closely with colleagues across the Nordic countries and be a trusted advisor to the business.

Some of your key responsibilities will include:

• Driving the development and implementation of our IMS strategy across the Nordic region

• Maintaining and improving processes, policies, and tools related to quality management, environmental management, and information security

• Leading internal and external audits within ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001

• Supporting governance initiatives and reporting activities

• Delivering engaging training and awareness activities across the organization

• Acting as a trusted advisor and collaborating with external stakeholders, certification bodies, customers, and internal teams across the Nordics

• Traveling to Konica Minolta offices across the Nordics 10-15 days per year

What success looks like

You create clarity where others see complexity.

You build strong partnerships across the business and inspire others to embrace quality and continuous improvement.

You balance attention to detail with a practical business mindset and know how to turn requirements into value for the organization.

What we're looking for

We know that great candidates do not always tick every box. If you are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every requirement.

Ideally, you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of experience working with ISO management systems, preferably ISO 9001, 14001 and/or 27001

• Knowledge of quality management, information security, sustainability, or related disciplines

• Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders at different levels

• A structured and proactive approach

• Experience managing projects or driving organizational improvements

• Professional English skills, written and spoken

Why join Konica Minolta?

At Konica Minolta, you will become part of a supportive Nordic team where collaboration comes naturally and where your contribution truly matters. Working together with another Nordic Quality Manager and reporting to the Nordic Head of Legal & Compliance, you will play a key role in driving quality and continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

We offer:

• Meaningful work with a clear purpose

• Nordic collaboration and international exposure

• Opportunity to influence strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• Flexible ways of working

• A culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion, and collaboration

About Konica Minolta as a workplace

At Konica Minolta, we value different perspectives and actively work to create an environment where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity in experience, background, and ways of thinking makes us stronger. This employer-branding wording is reflected in the attached recruitment material.

We offer a professional environment with strong collaboration, flexibility in everyday work, and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital development across the business. The attached recruitment template also highlights benefits such as pension, health insurance, lunch arrangement, fitness facilities, and social activities.

Practical information

• Location: Copenhagen / Ballerup area, onsite setup

• Employment type: Full-time

• Salary: According to qualifications

• Employment date: 1st of January 2027 or before

How to apply

Please send your application and CV no later than 10 November 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to connect with our Head of Nordic Legal & Compliance, Kristian Øhrstrøm at Kristian.Ohrstrom@konicaminolta.dk.

Feel free to submit your application already today – we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right match. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Konica Minolta:

Konica Minolta Business Solutions Denmark a/s is a leading provider of printing solutions for office and production environments. Our portfolio ranges from hardware and print software to automation and data security, and we also deliver solutions within Document Management and Cyber Security.

In Denmark, we have approximately 120 employees and an annual revenue of DKK 260 million, spanning sales, service, and support across IT, print and copy solutions, as well as digital services. Globally, Konica Minolta employs around 40,000 people.

www.konicaminolta.dk
